name: nicaragua-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Nicaragua income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta, IR) on employment income (rentas del trabajo) of residents for tax year 2026. It gives the art. 23 Ley de Concertacion Tributaria (Ley 822) scale (exempt to C$100,000 of annual net income, then 15%, 20%, 25% and 30% with base amounts of C$15,000, C$45,000 and C$82,500), the deduction of INSS and savings fund contributions, exempt items (13th month, severance up to five months and C$500,000, social security benefits, expense reimbursements), the definitive retentions (15% on severance above C$500,000, 25% on board fees, 20% on non-residents), the filing rule for two or more employers and the 90-day annual return. Trigger phrases include IR rentas del trabajo, tabla progresiva articulo 23, salario Nicaragua impuesto, DGI and declaracion anual IR asalariados.
